_comment: Default answers for the Frido Consumer Survey form.
_instructions: Keys are question indices (0-based). Questions not listed here are randomized.
Q0  — Are you aware of 'Frido'?           [radio: Yes | No | Don't Know]
Q1  — Know Ergonomic Products?             [radio: Yes | No | Don't Know]
Q2  — Where first heard about Frido?       [checkbox: 15 source options — pick 1+]
Q3  — Product categories aware of?         [checkbox: 6 product categories]
Q4  — Aware of health benefits?            [radio: Yes | No | Don't Know]
Q8  — Rank product attributes              [grid 5x5 — not configurable via defaults]
Q9  — Rank product offerings               [grid 5x5 — not configurable via defaults]
Q10 — Perception Likert (30 statements)    [grid 30x5 — not configurable via defaults]
Q12 — Gender                               [radio: Male | Female | Prefer not to say | Other]
For checkbox questions (Q2, Q3), provide 'answer' as a list of option strings.
Set 'randomize': true to force randomization even if 'answer' is provided.

0._note: First question — always Yes as required
